mapper.select: select u1.U_Name as createUname, u2.U_Name as smSendUserName, mn.* from Sys_Message mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Create_Uid left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Sm_Send_User where mn.id=#{id}

select u1.U_Name as createUname, u2.U_Name as smSendUserName, mn.* from Sys_Message mn left join SYS_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Create_Uid left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Sm_Send_User
and INSTR(mn.Sm_Title,#{params.smTitle})
and INSTR(mn.Sm_Type,#{params.smType})
and INSTR(mn.Sm_Content,#{params.smContent})
and INSTR(mn.Smt_Code,#{params.smtCode})
and INSTR(mn.Sm_Send_Type,#{params.smSendType})
and INSTR(u1.U_Name,#{params.createUname})
and INSTR(u2.U_Name,#{params.smSendUserName})
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Create_Time DESC
